---
title: "@@FILE@@"
subtitle: "Step @@NUM@@ of @@NAME@@"
---

- **Purpose.** [One sentence: what this step answers or prepares.]
- **Run.** `quarto render @@PATH@@` from the analysis folder; the Snakefile does it. Paths are relative to that folder.
- **Inputs.** `@@INPUT@@` [producer or `[gap]`]
- **Outputs.** `@@OUTPUT@@` [what the table holds]; this page, `outputs/@@STEM@@/@@STEM@@.html`.

## Parameters

```{r}
# Parameters -------------------------------------------------------------------
# scilintr stage: replace this line with `# STAGE: <stage>` (blind_qc, selection, evaluation or library;
#   label columns are allowed only in evaluation) so its label and stage rules run on this file.
STEP <- Sys.getenv("STEP_DIR") # this step's folder, outputs/@@STEM@@, set by the Snakefile
OUTPUTS <- Sys.getenv("OUTPUTS") # outputs/, to read earlier steps
INPUT <- @@INPUT_R@@
OUTPUT <- @@OUTPUT_R@@
SEED <- 0 # every stochastic step below uses this
```

## Load data

```{r}
# Load data --------------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(SEED)

stop("@@FILE@@ is not written yet")
```

## Session

```{r}
# Session info -----------------------------------------------------------------
writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), file.path(STEP, "logs", "@@STEM@@.session.txt"))
```
